findings.description: Changing the regex check from match() to fullmatch() silently alters which exceptions match a pattern. Patterns that previously matched a prefix of the message no longer match.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") is used and the raised exception's str is "Connection refused: host:80". Before, re.match finds a prefix match and the exception is retried. Now fullmatch requires the whole string to match, so _check returns False and the exception is not retried. Impact: retries stop silently for existing users who relied on prefix matching, and the errors propagate immediately. The commit title only announces accepting empty messages, so this behavior change is unannounced.
